name: Education
description: Windows MDM settings in the Education category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow Graphing Calculator (User)
properties.description: This policy setting allows you to control whether graphing functionality is available in the Windows Calculator app. If you disable this policy setting, graphing functionality will not be accessible in the Windows Calculator app. If you enable or don't configure this policy setting, users will be able to access graphing functionality.

properties.name: Default Printer Name (User)
properties.description: This policy sets user's default printer

properties.name: Enable Edu Themes
properties.description: This policy setting allows you to control whether EDU-specific theme packs are available in Settings > Personalization. If you disable or don't configure this policy setting, EDU-specific theme packs will not be included. If you enable this policy setting, users will be able to personalize their devices with EDU-specific themes.

properties.name: Is Education Environment
properties.description: This policy setting allows tenant to control whether to declare this OS as an education environment

properties.name: Prevent Adding New Printers (User)
properties.description: Boolean that specifies whether or not to prevent user to install new printers

properties.name: Printer Names (User)
properties.description: This policy provisions per-user network printers
